# Zoom
> Trusted collaboration platform for meetings, chat, phone, contact center, events, and AI-powered workplace tools.

Zoom provides communication, productivity, customer experience, and developer platforms across Zoom Workplace, business services, AI features, and APIs. This guide prioritizes product documentation, support resources, developer references, and key product areas.

## Core Platform
- [Zoom Homepage](https://zoom.us/): Main entry point for Zoom’s collaboration platform and account access.
- [Pricing](https://zoom.us/pricing): Plans and pricing for meetings, phone, webinars, rooms, and other products.
- [Support](https://support.zoom.com/hc/en): Help center for setup, troubleshooting, account management, and product guidance.
- [Zoom Workplace](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/): Overview of Zoom’s workplace collaboration products and capabilities.
- [Business Services](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/business-services/): Overview of customer experience, events, and business communication offerings.

## Zoom Workplace Products
- [Meetings](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/virtual-meetings/): Video meetings platform for collaboration, screen sharing, and hybrid work.
- [Team Chat](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/team-chat/): Persistent messaging for teams, channels, file sharing, and collaboration.
- [Phone](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/voip-phone/): Cloud VoIP phone system for calling, routing, and business telephony.
- [Rooms](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/meeting-rooms/): Conference room software and hardware experiences for hybrid meetings.
- [Mail & Calendar](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/email-calendar/): Integrated email and calendar tools within the Zoom workplace experience.
- [Scheduler](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/appointment-scheduler/): Appointment scheduling for external bookings and calendar coordination.
- [Whiteboard](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/online-whiteboard/): Collaborative digital whiteboarding for brainstorming, planning, and workshops.
- [AI Companion](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/ai-companion/): AI assistant features across meetings, chat, docs, and productivity workflows.

## Workspace and Collaboration Tools
- [Hub](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/hub/): Shared collaboration hub for content, meetings, and team coordination.
- [Collaborative Docs](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/collaborative-docs/): AI-powered documents for meeting follow-up, planning, and teamwork.
- [Clips](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/screen-recorder/): Screen and video recording for async communication and knowledge sharing.
- [Workvivo](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/workvivo/): Employee experience platform for communication, engagement, and internal culture.
- [Video Management](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/video-management/): Video content hosting, management, and internal communications distribution.
- [Workspace Reservation](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/meeting-rooms/features/workspace/): Desk and room booking tools for hybrid office coordination.
- [Digital Signage](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/meeting-rooms/features/workspace/#digital-signage): Signage features for workplace communications and office displays.
- [Visitor Management](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/meeting-rooms/features/workspace/#visitor-management): Visitor check-in and workplace access management capabilities.

## Customer Experience and Business Services
- [Contact Center](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/contact-center/): Omnichannel contact center platform for customer support and engagement.
- [Revenue Accelerator](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/conversation-intelligence/): Conversation intelligence for sales coaching, insights, and deal execution.
- [CX Insights](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/cx-insights/): Analytics and insights for customer experience operations and performance.
- [Events](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/events/): Platform for virtual and hybrid events, sessions, and attendee engagement.
- [Webinars](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/webinars/): Webinar hosting for broadcasts, lead generation, and audience interaction.

## Developer Platform
- [Developers](https://developers.zoom.us/): Developer portal for building apps, integrations, and Zoom-based solutions.
- [Documentation](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/): Central documentation for Zoom APIs, SDKs, and platform capabilities.
- [API Reference](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/): Reference materials for Zoom REST APIs and endpoint usage.
- [SDKs](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/sdk/): SDK documentation for embedding Zoom experiences in applications.
- [Meeting SDK](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/meeting-sdk/): Build custom meeting experiences with Zoom’s Meeting SDK.
- [Video SDK](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/video-sdk/): Build fully customizable real-time video applications with Zoom infrastructure.
- [Marketplace](https://marketplace.zoom.us/): App marketplace for Zoom integrations, extensions, and published apps.
- [Build App Marketplace Apps](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/zoom-apps/): Guidance for creating in-client Zoom Apps and integrations.

## Support and Admin Resources
- [Zoom Support Home](https://support.zoom.com/hc/en): Starting point for product help, troubleshooting, and account assistance.
- [Learning Center](https://learning.zoom.us/): Training courses and educational resources for Zoom users and admins.
- [Community](https://community.zoom.com/): User community for discussions, product questions, and shared solutions.
- [Status Page](https://status.zoom.us/): Service availability and incident reporting for Zoom systems.
- [Trust Center](https://explore.zoom.us/en/trust/): Security, privacy, compliance, and trust information for Zoom services.
- [Download Center](https://zoom.us/download): Downloads for Zoom desktop clients, mobile apps, and plugins.

## Resources and Insights
- [Blog](https://blog.zoom.us/): Product updates, company news, customer stories, and collaboration insights.
- [Customer Stories](https://www.zoom.com/en/customer-stories/): Case studies showing how organizations use Zoom products.
- [Resource Library](https://www.zoom.com/en/resources/): Reports, ebooks, webinars, and educational business resources.
- [Events Resource Center](https://www.zoom.com/en/resources/events/): Resources focused on virtual and hybrid event strategy.
- [Contact Center Resources](https://www.zoom.com/en/resources/contact-center/): Guides and materials for customer experience and contact center teams.

## AI at Zoom
- [AI at Zoom](https://www.zoom.com/en/ai/): Overview of Zoom’s AI strategy, features, and responsible AI approach.
- [AI Companion](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/ai-companion/): Product page for Zoom’s AI assistant across workplace workflows.
- [AI Companion for Meetings](https://support.zoom.com/hc/en/article?id=zm_kb&sysparm_article=KB0058012): Support guidance for AI Companion meeting features and usage.
- [AI Companion for Team Chat](https://support.zoom.com/hc/en/article?id=zm_kb&sysparm_article=KB0064886): Support guidance for AI-powered chat assistance and message workflows.
- [AI Companion for Docs](https://support.zoom.com/hc/en/article?id=zm_kb&sysparm_article=KB0067728): Support guidance for AI features in collaborative documents.
